Introduction

What Is a Private Limited Company?

A Private Limited Company is a separate legal entity registered under the Companies Act, 2013, offering limited liability protection to its shareholders. It's the structure of choice for founders planning to raise external funding or scale beyond a small team.

We manage name approval, DSC and DIN, drafting of MOA/AOA, and ROC filing — so you can focus on building the business.

Advantages & Disadvantages

Advantages

  • Limited liability for shareholders
  • Separate legal entity from its founders
  • Easier to raise funding from investors
  • Perpetual succession — the company continues regardless of ownership changes
  • Greater credibility with banks, vendors and clients

Disadvantages

  • Higher compliance burden than a proprietorship or partnership
  • Mandatory annual filings and audit requirements
  • Higher initial and ongoing professional costs
  • Restrictions on transfer of shares

Eligibility

Who Can Register a Private Limited Company

  • Minimum 2 and maximum 200 shareholders
  • Minimum 2 directors, at least one resident in India
  • No minimum capital requirement
  • A registered office address in India
  • Directors must have a valid DIN and DSC

Step-by-Step

Registration Process & Timeline

1. Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)

Obtain DSC for all proposed directors — typically 1 working day.

2. Name Reservation

Apply for company name approval via the RUN/SPICe+ service — 1 to 2 working days.

3. Drafting MOA & AOA

We draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association reflecting your business objects.

4. SPICe+ Filing with ROC

Incorporation application filed with the Registrar of Companies along with PAN & TAN application.

5. Certificate of Incorporation

Once approved, you receive the Certificate of Incorporation, PAN and TAN — typically within 10–15 working days overall.

Required Documents

What You'll Need

  • PAN card of all directors & shareholders
  • Aadhaar / address proof of all directors
  • Passport-size photographs
  • Proof of registered office (utility bill + NOC from owner)
  • Rent agreement, if applicable

Annual Compliance

Ongoing Requirements After Registration

  • Annual ROC filing (AOC-4 & MGT-7)
  • Statutory audit of financial statements
  • Income tax return filing
  • Board meetings & annual general meeting
  • Director KYC (DIR-3 KYC)

Post-Registration Requirements

Immediately After Incorporation

  • Open a current bank account in the company's name
  • Deposit subscribed share capital
  • Apply for GST registration, if applicable
  • Issue share certificates to shareholders
  • Appoint the first statutory auditor within 30 days
